epic.title: cleanup-c-liveness-rail
epic.intent_and_why: Two questions the fleet asks constantly and gets wrong: is anything already running (#599, registry liveness), and whose gate is this (#549, per-agent-key Stop imperative leak).

definition_of_done: active_duplicate() corroborates liveness via a three-state (active/stale/unknown) query, fail-toward-active, instead of trusting a raw status string.
decide_stop keeps blocking exactly the same stops, but names the owning session instead of relaying a subordinate's imperative for an entry reachable only through a per-agent key.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Both directions of #599 shown wrong-before/right-after with the real crew-runs.json shape; both halves of #549 (still blocked, reason no longer leaks) proven together, not separately.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Independent reviewer APPROVE per gate, adversarial mutation-testing of the load-bearing tests, full clean-env suite green, main baseline re-measured at gate time.
good_enough.appetite: One working session for both issues (#599 first, since it is what makes the next four-Commander wave safe).

hard_constraints: decide_stop must refuse exactly the same stops it refuses today
No auto-reaping or auto-abandonment as a side effect of a liveness read
fixed_decisions: pidless-means-heartbeat, 8h window (settled/measured, computed from this run's own corpus sweep)

current_wave.objective: Ship #599 and #549 on cleanup/c-liveness-rail, park at archive for the Admiral to merge.
exit_criteria: Both gates closed with independent reviewer APPROVE
Full clean-env suite green at head
Main baseline re-measured at gate time, failure-set difference empty

issues.title: Registry liveness: active_duplicate() trusts a raw status string
issues.desired_outcome: A corroborated-dead entry frees a launch slot; an uncorroborated one still blocks.
issues.useful_now: Makes the next four-Commander concurrent wave safe -- doctrine requires asking the registry before every dispatch.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: 9 new tests + the real epic-568-441 phantom shape; both directions proven.
issues.implementation_latitude: Corroboration window for pid-less entries; shape of the three-state result.
hard_constraints_no_gos: No write path may set abandoned as a side effect of this read.

issues.title: decide_stop hands an orchestrator its subordinate's gates
issues.desired_outcome: Keep the block; drop the imperative for a per-agent-key-only entry.
issues.useful_now: Removes a candidate mechanism lane B's #600 is measuring -- B can re-measure rather than reasoning about a stale world.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Updated composite-key test proves both halves (still blocked, reason owner-named); control test proves the fix is scoped.
issues.implementation_latitude: How provenance travels out of session_view; the refusal wording.
hard_constraints_no_gos: decide_session_start must show zero behavior change.
decide_stop's gating outcome must be byte-identical to before.

wave_forecast.outcome: Lane B (#600) re-measures now that #549 has removed one of its two candidate mechanisms.
wave_forecast.why_likely: The launch order names this as the one required cross-lane interaction; a durable notification was left in the Admiral's shared work area.
entry_conditions: #549 merged or Lane B pulls cleanup/c-liveness-rail directly

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether the 8h heartbeat-stale window is right for a genuinely long-running healthy external dispatch this repo hasn't observed yet.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: The next time an external crew legitimately runs close to 8h, observe whether it was misread as stale.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: Corpus sweep: longest healthy completed external run ~3h30m, shortest confirmed phantom ~22h27m; 8h sits well clear of both.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Add a periodic heartbeat-touch for external entries (out of scope this lane; flagged as a triage candidate) so the window measures true liveness rather than time-since-dispatch.

parked_possibilities: A periodic heartbeat-writer for external-backend crew entries
Extending decide_session_start with the same provenance-aware rendering as decide_stop (not requested by the launch order; same mechanism would compose cleanly if ever needed)

completed_outcomes.outcome: entry_liveness() (three-bucket, fail-toward-active) added and wired into active_duplicate(); HEARTBEAT_STALE_SECONDS=28800 documented from a corpus sweep. Committed cbd18faf.
completed_outcomes.evidence: 9 new tests in tests/test_crew_launcher.py::EntryLivenessTests (both directions on the real epic-568-441 shape); pre-existing test_duplicate_active_lock_is_refused kept green unmodified; independent reviewer APPROVE with an adversarial mutation test proving the tests load-bearing.

completed_outcomes.outcome: _session_keys/session_view_provenance/_owning_session_reason added; decide_stop's render step branches on ownership, decide_session_start untouched. Committed 915daefa.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Updated test_stop_blocks_on_mid_flight_spine_held_only_under_a_composite_key proves both halves (still blocked, imperative absent, owner named); new control test proves the fix is scoped; independent reviewer APPROVE with two isolated adversarial mutations proving reason AND additionalContext leak-guards both load-bearing.

wave_evidence.claim: active_duplicate() no longer blocks a launch on a corroborated-dead crew, and still blocks on an uncorroborated one.
wave_evidence.expected: A dead-PID cli entry frees the slot; a live-PID entry still blocks; a real epic-568-441-shaped phantom (external, >8h stale) frees the slot; the same shape within the 8h window still blocks.
wave_evidence.observed: All four proven in tests/test_crew_launcher.py::EntryLivenessTests (evidence items 1-4), plus the pre-existing test_duplicate_active_lock_is_refused kept green unmodified (bucket-3 regression guard).
wave_evidence.source: tests/test_crew_launcher.py, reproduced independently by the Commander and again by the reviewer

wave_evidence.claim: decide_stop still blocks exactly the same stops, but no longer relays a subordinate's imperative for a per-agent-key-only entry.
wave_evidence.expected: The updated composite-key test shows decision=='block' AND the imperative absent from both reason and additionalContext AND the owning key present instead; a control test shows a session's own mid-flight gate is unaffected.
wave_evidence.observed: Both proven in tests/test_spine_rail.py; reviewer ran two isolated adversarial mutations (one breaking the reason leak-guard, one breaking the additionalContext leak-guard) and confirmed both fail as expected, then cleanly reverted.
